title: Toronto Backs Nearly 10,000 Rental Homes Through Second Round of Incentives
summary:
The City of Toronto has conditionally selected 19 developments containing 9,667 rental homes, including 2,059 affordable, rent-controlled homes, for municipal incentives intended to get construction started within a year. The second phase of the City’s Purpose-Built Rental Housing Incentives stream covers projects across 12 wards, with proponents required to meet the 12-month construction deadline to retain eligibility for support.

“Our Purpose-Built Rental Housing Incentives program is getting rental homes built faster,” said Mayor Olivia Chow. “In this second phase, we’re supporting 19 shovel-ready projects across Toronto. title: Cladding and Finishing Touches Progress at Bijou on Bloor
summary:

Designed by BDP Quadrangle for Plaza, the 12-storey condominium occupies the former Humber Cinema site in Toronto’s Bloor West Village, just west of Jane station.
